name: Google Notes
author: Walter Monschein
description: View, check off, and quick-add items in a Google Keep checklist note from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Synced Google Keep checklist popup with quick-add, interactive checkboxes, and multi-note switching. Unofficial — uses the same reverse-engineered API as Home Assistant's google_keep_sync integration.

schema.label: Note Title
schema.description: The title of the Google Keep checklist note to sync (must be a note with 'Show checkboxes' enabled).

schema.label: Sync Interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often notes are fetched in the background.

schema.label: Show checked items
schema.description: Show recently checked-off items at the bottom of the list.

schema.label: Bar badge counts
schema.description: 'all' counts all unchecked items; 'none' hides the badge.
